failure_modes.name: Query_Form_Mismatch
failure_modes.evidence: Query hop 2: 'When was the Battle of Harlem Heights fought during the American Revolutionary War, and how does its date differ from the Battle of White Plains?' - This is a natural-language yes/no question format asking when something was fought and how dates differ, rather than a well-formed entity-based query.

failure_modes.name: Query_Stagnation
failure_modes.evidence: All three hops retrieved substantially the same core documents: 'Battle of Harlem Heights', 'Battle of White Plains', 'New York and New Jersey campaign', and 'Battle of Long Island' appear in hop 1, hop 2, and hop 3. The queries did not advance to retrieve new information despite the solver having already identified the key facts in summary_1 and summary_2.

failure_modes.name: Repetitive_Output_Loop
failure_modes.evidence: Summary_1 states: 'The Battle of Harlem Heights was fought on September 16, 1776, while the Battle of White Plains was fought on October 28, 1776 near White Plains, New York.' Summary_2 repeats nearly identically: 'it was fought on September 16, 1776, not October 28, 1776. The date of October 28, 1776 corresponds to the Battle of White Plains'. Both summaries convey the same verification result without progressing the analysis.
